Common questions

What does the $25 estimate cover?

It covers our time and travel for a thorough on-site evaluation of your property.

Do I get the $25 back?

Yes, as a credit. It is applied to your final invoice when you book with us.

What services do you offer?

Remodeling, demolition, cleaning (including carpet cleaning and power washing), and mobile mechanic service.

Do you work with businesses?

Yes. We serve both residential and commercial clients.

About Damarko Luxury Enterprises LLC

We believe every property deserves luxury-level care.

We are a Cincinnati-based company offering comprehensive solutions for homes, businesses and vehicles. From remodeling and demolition to cleaning, car detailing, moving services and mobile mechanic work, our experienced team transforms and maintains your property with precision and pride.

Whether you need a single repair or a full renovation, you get luxury-quality workmanship, reliable service and affordable pricing from one trusted partner. We proudly serve residential and commercial clients in Cincinnati, Ohio and the tri-state area.

Our story

Damarko Luxury Enterprises LLC is a Cincinnati-based company offering comprehensive solutions for homes, businesses and vehicles. Our experienced team is dedicated to transforming and maintaining your property with precision and pride.

Whether you need to remodel, restore, clean or repair, DLE is your trusted partner. From a single repair to a full renovation, we deliver luxury-quality workmanship, reliable service and affordable pricing.
